# Kenet Mimarlık

> Kenet Mimarlık is an architecture and interior design studio based in Bandırma, Balıkesir, Türkiye.

Kenet Mimarlık provides architectural design, permit project preparation, interior architecture, 3D visualization, custom furniture design, and design-build/site supervision services. The studio works in Bandırma and the surrounding Balıkesir region.

## Official pages

- [Ana Sayfa](https://www.kenetmimarlik.com/): Kenet Mimarlık overview and selected work.
- [Hakkımızda](https://www.kenetmimarlik.com/hakkimizda): Studio, founders, and design approach.
- [Hizmetler](https://www.kenetmimarlik.com/hizmetler): Permit projects, architectural design, interior architecture, visualization, and implementation.
- [Projeler](https://www.kenetmimarlik.com/projeler): Selected residential and commercial projects.
- [İletişim](https://www.kenetmimarlik.com/iletisim): Bandırma office address and contact details.
- [English site](https://www.kenetmimarlik.com/en): English version of the official website.
